minor.issue: With a valid token, a JSON body that is not an object (string or array) caused a 500 (AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get'). FIXED by the testing agent: added an isinstance(payload, dict) check that returns 400 'Invalid JSON'.

One older access-log line, from before the redaction filter was added, contains a webhook token in plaintext. That token is no longer valid because the testing agent rotated the webhook once, as allowed. Consider truncating or rotating that log.

critical_code_review_comments: provider._apply sets status to configured_unverified but keeps last_verification, so after a config change the UI still shows the old 'Last test' checks. Consider marking them stale.
test_connection: when Bolna returns 404 for the agent, auth is marked 'verified'. Bolna may also return 404 for an agent that belongs to another account, so 'verified' may overstate it.

bolna_webhook: X-Forwarded-For is taken from the client and can be spoofed, so ip_allowlisted is informational only (which is fine because the execution is re-fetched from Bolna). There is no limit on payload size.
dry_run does not check whether the interview date is in the past, or the call window/limits. Make sure the Phase 4B gate covers these.
